solutions.title: Include-current recursion
solutions.strategy: At each candidate, choose it again or move to the next candidate.

timeComplexity.explanation: The recursion explores candidate reuse branches up to the number of generated partial combinations R.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output stores all valid combinations and the recursion path stores one active combination.

solutions.title: Loop backtracking
solutions.strategy: Loop over candidate choices from the current start index and recurse with the same index for reuse.

timeComplexity.explanation: The search cost scales with the number of explored partial and complete combinations R.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output dominates; recursion depth is bounded by target divided by the smallest candidate.
